milestones.title: Phase 0 - Safety baseline
milestones.description: Reproducible repository and immediate fail-closed correctness.

milestones.title: Phase 2 - Graph-driven engine
milestones.description: Closed claim taxonomy and executable graph parity.

milestones.title: Phase 4 - Independent validation
milestones.description: Golden cases and governed knowledge expansion.

milestones.title: Phase 6 - Controlled release
milestones.description: Certification, supported scope, rollback, and release.

milestones.title: Third-party / Article 8 expansion
milestones.description: Deferred beyond body-model v0.1. Article 8 actual-loss ceilings and third-party expansion.

issues.title: Enforce the claim JSON Schema at every runtime entry point
issues.objective: Reject malformed or incomplete claims before classification or calculation and make the schema the actual runtime contract.
acceptance: calc, json, classify, and direct public compute entry points use one validator
The schema is closed where appropriate and has branch-specific conditional requirements
Boolean, enum, unknown-field, and missing-field failures have stable machine-readable codes
All schema-shaped examples and fixtures are validated in tests
validation: Input and money cases in docs/VALIDATION_GATES.md

issues.title: Define IRR-only persistence, numeric invariants, and rounding
issues.objective: Prevent negative, non-finite, ambiguous-unit, fractional-IRR, and overflow-like monetary behavior.
acceptance: Persistence and API boundaries use non-negative integer IRR
Display-unit conversion is explicit and cannot contradict an _irr field
One documented rounding rule is applied at the defined calculation boundary
Decimal results are serialized without conversion through float
validation: Negative, NaN, infinity, zero, precision, unit-conflict, and large-value tests

issues.title: Block body settlement when franchise economics are missing
issues.objective: Make U02 genuinely blocking instead of silently substituting a zero franchise.
acceptance: Applicable body branches return no single payable when required franchise terms are absent
The result identifies U02 and the policy/product/version artifact needed
Explicit no-franchise coverage requires sourced policy evidence rather than omission
Existing happy-path cases provide traceable franchise terms
validation: Partial, total loss, glass, and theft missing-franchise regressions

issues.title: Correct Article 8 actual-loss ceilings and zero handling
issues.objective: Ensure Article 8 never pays above actual proven loss and never treats zero as missing.
acceptance: TP payable is bounded by actual loss, corresponding damage, and the financial limit
Zero is preserved as a supplied amount; None alone means missing
Dual-coverage fields reconcile to the same actual loss without double recovery
Legal-recovery caps use explicit None checks
validation: All Article 8 min(actual, corresponding, limit) permutations

issues.title: Require total-loss evidence and reconcile declared classification
issues.objective: Prevent a declared branch from bypassing the total-loss threshold or other classification evidence.
acceptance: A total-loss settlement requires the threshold evidence or an authorized documented override
Below and exactly 75 percent cannot settle through the total-loss branch
Declared branch conflicts return a review/refusal state
Classification confidence and basis enter the audit trace

issues.title: Establish reproducible CI, repository governance, and safety posture
issues.objective: Make the complete repository and its decision-support limitations reproducible and reviewable.
acceptance: A clean environment can install test dependencies and run the full gate
CI runs graph validation, fixtures, pytest, compilation, and planning-manifest validation
Roadmap, validation gates, contribution policy, security policy, and issue templates are committed
README reports the actual test count and links project controls

issues.title: Audit and reclassify every legal and regulatory source
issues.objective: Confirm publishing authority, source tier, current status, and applicability for every amount-affecting rule.
acceptance: Official source is preferred and mirrors are marked as mirrors
Every rule has clause-level locator, retrieval date, and reviewer
Superseded or uncertain material is explicitly represented
Two-person authority review is recorded
validation: Manual sample verification against official texts

issues.title: Implement effective-dated regulatory and policy snapshots
issues.objective: Select law, annual parameters, policy, endorsement, and insurer procedure by event and policy dates.
acceptance: Event date and policy inception/version are mandatory where relevant
Rule and parameter selection uses explicit effective intervals
No implicit current-year fallback is used for historical claims
Snapshot identity is stored in every result

issues.title: Replace annual parameters with primary official evidence and refresh workflow
issues.objective: Make annual diyah, conventional threshold, and minimum financial values primary-sourced and reproducibly derived.
acceptance: Primary Judiciary or official Central Insurance evidence is recorded
Derived values are recalculated and independently checked
Missing next-year parameters fail closed for affected classification
Refresh and revalidation instructions are automated

issues.title: Complete provenance and confidence across every executable dependency
issues.objective: Include rules, operators, parameters, policy terms, classifier decisions, evidence, and uncertainties in the audit model.
acceptance: Every executable node has a validated envelope or derived dependency chain
Result confidence includes every amount-affecting dependency
Formula confidence and evidence confidence are separately named
Missing provenance blocks certification of the result

issues.title: Add source integrity hashes, locators, and revalidation enforcement
issues.objective: Detect source drift and make clause-level evidence reproducible.
acceptance: Source records contain stable locator and content hash where lawful
Retrieval and revalidation dates are machine-validated
Overdue release-critical sources fail the release gate
Changed source content creates a review event

issues.title: Finalize the closed claim, evidence, and override taxonomy
issues.objective: Replace ambiguous free-text signals with controlled evidence and explicit reviewed overrides.
acceptance: Every branch has required evidence, predicates, allowed statuses, and override rules
Coverage and exclusion predicates have a closed executable vocabulary
Keyword matching cannot by itself deny or grant coverage
Override actor, reason, time, and source are audited

issues.title: Make graph branch and operator configuration authoritative
issues.objective: Execute or compile branch plans from graph data so graph and code cannot silently diverge.
acceptance: Branch operators and order are loaded from validated graph plans
Unsupported implementations prevent plan activation
Graph-plan version is attached to the result
Changing an isolated graph order changes scenarios without editing branch code
validation: Graph mutation and plan snapshot tests

issues.title: Prove every configured guard is invoked on every applicable path
issues.objective: Replace callable-exists validation with actual guard-to-path enforcement evidence.
acceptance: Guard applicability is part of the execution plan
Removing or bypassing a required guard fails CI
Guard outcomes are stable and machine-readable
All 13 current guards have positive and negative tests

issues.title: Add property, metamorphic, mutation, and model-parity tests
issues.objective: Test invariants beyond the authored fixture outputs and detect tests that pass after meaningful rule breakage.
acceptance: Core monetary invariants have generated tests
Monotonic and cap metamorphic properties are documented
Mutation score threshold is defined for calculation modules
Graph formulas and Python results are cross-checked

issues.title: Define insurer document acquisition and approval protocol
issues.objective: Acquire authentic product/version documents with custody, scope, redaction, and reviewer records.
acceptance: Document request checklist covers franchise, endorsements, worksheets, and Article 8 inputs
Authenticity and effective scope are reviewed
Personal data is redacted before repository use
Rejected or ambiguous documents cannot activate an adapter

issues.title: Implement versioned insurer franchise adapters
issues.objective: Resolve U02 by product, coverage, claim sequence, and policy version without overriding law.
acceptance: Adapter schema captures rate/amount, minimum, base, sequence, surcharge, waiver, and source
Out-of-scope policy versions refuse
At least five approved worksheets reconcile for the first adapter
Explicit zero-franchise cover is source-backed

issues.title: Resolve Article 10 and franchise operator order from insurer worksheets
issues.objective: Resolve U01 only for insurer/product/version scopes proven by real underinsured partial-loss examples.
acceptance: Each resolution cites a complete calculation worksheet or authoritative procedure
Order is scoped by insurer/product/version and effective interval
Unproven scopes continue returning scenarios
At least two amount-sensitive examples validate each resolved order

issues.title: Calibrate standalone-glass endorsement behavior
issues.objective: Resolve U03 and U11 from actual endorsement wording, including installation, limits, franchise, underinsurance, and history treatment.
acceptance: Standalone and base-peril glass paths remain distinct
All economic terms are versioned and sourced
Unknown underinsurance treatment remains blocking
Five representative glass cases reconcile

issues.title: Integrate governed Article 8 assessor correspondence inputs
issues.objective: Resolve U06/U07 through assessor-signed component mappings and annual reference sets, never a whole-car ratio.
acceptance: Each mapping records damaged component, matched/similar reference, valuation date, source, and assessor
Annual qualifying reference set is effective-dated
Missing mappings continue refusing
Actual-loss and policy caps remain enforced after mapping
validation: Exact-part, similar-part, multiple-reference, missing-map, and cap cases

issues.title: Resolve battery/tire interaction and rescue denominator
issues.objective: Obtain authoritative operational evidence for U04 and U05 or retain explicit scoped uncertainty.
acceptance: Evidence distinguishes universal legal rule from insurer procedure
Resolution is scoped and versioned
All candidate modes remain testable for historical snapshots
Unsupported scopes never inherit another insurer's setting

issues.title: Build an independently reviewed anonymized golden-case corpus
issues.objective: Validate against qualified human decisions rather than only examples authored from the same report.
acceptance: Every supported branch has positive, boundary, uncertainty, and refusal cases
Expected outcomes are independently approved and provenance-linked
Cases are anonymized and checked for re-identification risk
Disagreements remain visible and block the affected scope

issues.title: Create immutable calculation snapshots and deterministic audit output
issues.objective: Reproduce every result from pinned input, code, graph, source, adapter, and parameter versions.
acceptance: Canonical serialization and calculation identifier are defined
Repeated runs are byte-stable for the same snapshot
Audit trace includes all inputs, operations, caps, uncertainties, and overrides
Snapshot verification detects altered dependencies

issues.title: Make knowledge ingestion atomic, recursive, and concurrency-safe
issues.objective: Prevent partial graph writes, missed nested contradictions, duplicate IDs, and concurrent lost updates.
acceptance: Ingestion validates a staged complete graph before atomic replacement
Nested values, lists, dates, scopes, and references participate in conflict analysis
Duplicate IDs within/across classes are refused
Failed and concurrent writes preserve the prior valid graph
validation: Failure injection after every write stage

issues.title: Complete privacy, security, and abuse threat model
issues.objective: Protect claimant data, source integrity, calculation authority, and audit history before a real-data pilot.
acceptance: Data classification, retention, redaction, access, and deletion policies are approved
Threat model covers malicious inputs, rule poisoning, privilege escalation, and audit tampering
Secrets are externalized and scanned
Incident response and affected-scope disable procedures are tested

issues.title: Build authenticated API and mandatory adjuster review workflow
issues.objective: Expose the deterministic engine with visible evidence and required human decisions, without autonomous payment.
acceptance: Authentication, authorization, rate limits, idempotency, and audit events are implemented
Reviewer sees inputs, formulas, sources, confidence components, and uncertainties
Overrides require role, reason, and second review for amount-affecting decisions
No endpoint can mark payment authorized

issues.title: Run and evaluate a 100-claim private shadow pilot
issues.objective: Measure agreement, refusal quality, operational usability, and safety on representative real claims without controlling payment.
acceptance: At least 100 representative claims receive dual review
Zero hidden blocking uncertainties and zero unexplained material variances remain
Disagreements are categorized into model, source, evidence, adapter, or workflow causes
Rollback, backup/restore, and incident exercises pass

issues.title: Assemble certification dossier and controlled release scope
issues.objective: Authorize only the branches, insurers, products, dates, and procedures supported by complete evidence.
acceptance: Supported/unsupported scope is machine-readable and user-visible
Release pins code, graph, sources, parameters, adapters, and validation dossier
Legal, claims, engineering, security, and product owners sign off
Rollback and emergency rule-disable procedures are demonstrated

issues.title: Add provenance-aware retrieval only after deterministic certification
issues.objective: Add GraphRAG for explanation and discovery while keeping all amounts inside the certified deterministic engine.
acceptance: Retrieval only uses approved versioned nodes and returns source locators
Generated text cannot invoke unapproved formulas or alter payable results
Unsupported questions produce a scoped refusal or human route
Retrieval quality and citation correctness are evaluated separately from calculation
